programs.description: DER reference metadata package; validate and localise prior to production. Stock transaction monitoring; DER ledger authoritative.

programStages.name: Registration Verification
programStages.description: Search for existing patient, resolve identity, verify consent, capture missing demographics, create tracked entity only if no match. Registration itself is not a second patient record.

programStages.name: Visit Check-in
programStages.description: Open a facility visit, assign encounter reference, choose service, and queue patient. A check-in event anchors downstream DER operational links.

programStages.name: Triage and Vital Signs
programStages.description: Assess urgency, record vitals, recognise red flags, and route immediately to emergency care where indicated.

programStages.name: Clinical Consultation
programStages.description: Record history, examination, assessment and treatment plan. Generate orders or direct services, and review returned results.

programStages.name: Laboratory Request
programStages.description: Create an order for laboratory testing. Each request event may use a shared order reference. Individual test lines must be modelled through an additional repeatable stage or DER order detail store.

programStages.name: Laboratory Specimen Collection
programStages.description: Receive request, capture collection and specimen identification, then register receipt.

programStages.name: Laboratory Results
programStages.description: Report results with test identity, units, reference notes, review and critical result escalation.

programStages.name: Imaging Request
programStages.description: Submit imaging order linked to the originating consultation.

programStages.name: Imaging Report
programStages.description: Record performed study, impression and reporting status; link to imaging request.

programStages.name: Procedure and Treatment
programStages.description: Record clinical procedures and procedures performed after orders or direct clinician decisions.

programStages.name: Prescription
programStages.description: Create medicine prescription; multiple medicine lines may be represented as multiple prescription events with common order reference.

programStages.name: Pharmacy Dispensing
programStages.description: Verify prescription, issue stock, capture partial fills and counselling. One event for each dispensed line/fulfilment.

programStages.name: Billing Charge
programStages.description: Cross-cutting charges from service points; one charge line per event, shared invoice reference, and source order/event reference. DHIS2 is a clinical reporting snapshot, not financial ledger.

programStages.name: Billing Payment
programStages.description: Record receipt evidence and payment status against an invoice. Real financial transaction, refunds, reconciliation and idempotency belong to authorised billing ledger.

programStages.name: Billing Clearance
programStages.description: Capture billing clearance or authorised exemption; urgent treatment must never be delayed by payment gating.

programStages.name: Clinical Review and Disposition
programStages.description: Review results and treatment completion, document diagnosis and disposition; follow-up date if needed.

programStages.name: Referral and Transfer
programStages.description: Send patient onward or between service points; retain receiving facility and reason and track completion.

programStages.name: Follow-up Encounter
programStages.description: Reassessment at a later visit, linked to visit and preceding episode through DER; a single longitudinal enrollment continues.

programStages.name: Admission Request and Bed Booking
programStages.description: Receive decision to admit; search existing patient; determine referral source and clinical priority; request appropriate bed.

programStages.name: Admission and Identity Verification
programStages.description: Verify identifiers, consent, allergies, identity bands and admission order; create IPD enrollment for this admission.

programStages.name: Initial Nursing Assessment
programStages.description: Document initial assessment, presenting concerns, functional status, skin risk and arrival observations.

programStages.name: Admission History and Physical
programStages.description: Perform comprehensive history, examination, medication reconciliation, allergy check, differential and treatment plan.

programStages.name: Patient Problems and Diagnoses
programStages.description: Maintain admission-specific active problem list, diagnosis status, coding and review date.

programStages.name: Ward Round and Clinical Progress
programStages.description: Capture repeatable ward round findings, decisions, interpretation and new orders.

programStages.name: Vital Signs and Early Warning
programStages.description: Collect observations repeatedly, calculate ward early warning score in DER if configured, and escalate deviations.

programStages.name: Medication Reconciliation
programStages.description: Reconcile pre-admission medicines, discontinue/continue instructions and interaction review.

programStages.name: Medication Prescription
programStages.description: Create medication order line with dose, frequency, route, duration, indication, and status.

programStages.name: Pharmacy Verification and Issue
programStages.description: Verify prescription, contraindications and batch availability; issue ward stock or patient-labelled medication.

programStages.name: Medication Administration Record
programStages.description: Capture actual administration against prescribed dose including omissions, refusals and adverse events.

programStages.name: Intravenous Fluids and Infusions
programStages.description: Document prescribed fluids, rate changes, start/stop, line safety and totals.

programStages.name: Laboratory Investigation Request
programStages.description: Order one or more lab tests, collection priority and indication.

programStages.name: Specimen Collection and Handover
programStages.description: Capture sample identity, collection, chain of custody and rejection.

programStages.name: Laboratory Results and Validation
programStages.description: Capture observations, result values, units, interpretation, review and release.

programStages.name: Imaging and Diagnostics Request
programStages.description: Request imaging examination with clinical indication, urgency, and contrast warnings.

programStages.name: Imaging Result and Report
programStages.description: Record performance, interpretation, report and critical notification.

programStages.name: Procedure and Intervention
programStages.description: Capture bedside procedures, consent, checklists, specimens, material use and outcome.

programStages.name: Surgery and Operating Theatre
programStages.description: Capture theatre booking, safety checklist, operation, team, anesthesia and immediate outcome.

programStages.name: Post Anaesthesia and Recovery
programStages.description: Capture handover, airway, vital signs, recovery score, pain and destination.

programStages.name: Nursing Care Plan and Interventions
programStages.description: Document nursing diagnoses, interventions, goals, observations and completion.

programStages.name: Intake Output and Fluid Balance
programStages.description: Capture oral/IV intake and urine/drainage/output, with running balance computed by DER.

programStages.name: Blood and Transfusion
programStages.description: Request, crossmatch and administer blood products, monitor reactions and trace unit.

programStages.name: Consultation and Specialty Review
programStages.description: Request and provide specialty opinions and recommended changes to care plan.

programStages.name: Ward Bed Transfer and Handover
programStages.description: Move patient between beds, wards and levels of care with receiving-unit acceptance.

programStages.name: Critical Care and Escalation
programStages.description: Document escalation trigger, level of care, monitoring and decision.

programStages.name: Allied Health and Rehabilitation
programStages.description: Capture therapy assessments, nutritional support, rehab sessions and advice.

programStages.name: Infection Prevention and Isolation
programStages.description: Document isolation precautions, infection surveillance and de-isolation.

programStages.name: Billing Charge and Claims
programStages.description: Generate charges for bed days, procedures, consumables, medicines, tests and other services; submit insured claims as appropriate.

programStages.name: Payment and Financial Clearance
programStages.description: Record payment status, receipt references, exemptions, deferrals, and discharge financial status.

programStages.name: Discharge Planning and Education
programStages.description: Plan medication, education, follow-up, equipment and patient readiness.

programStages.name: Discharge Summary and Disposition
programStages.description: Final diagnoses, treatment summary, complications, medications, investigations, patient status and outcome.

programStages.name: Referral Transfer Out and Continuity
programStages.description: Document referral reason, receiving facility, transport and handover acknowledgement.

programStages.name: Death and Mortuary Handover
programStages.description: Capture death certification references and confidential mortuary transfer.

programStages.name: Post Discharge Follow-up and Readmission
programStages.description: Record outreach, followup, adverse events and links to subsequent admission.

programStages.name: INV - Opening Balance and Stocktake
programStages.description: Capture controlled baseline quantity per commodity, batch, and stock location. Do not double-post opening balances.

programStages.name: INV - Goods Receipt
programStages.description: Receive from supplier/upstream store; inspect and put away

programStages.name: INV - Issue to Service Point
programStages.description: Issue verified pick/pack quantity to requesting unit

programStages.name: INV - Department Receipt
programStages.description: Confirm receipt of a previously dispatched transfer

programStages.name: INV - Patient Dispensing
programStages.description: Record batch-specific medicine issue after pharmacist verification

programStages.name: INV - Clinical Consumption
programStages.description: Record actual reagent, test kit and procedure use

programStages.name: INV - Return and Quarantine
programStages.description: Receive return into quarantine; do not make it immediately available

programStages.name: INV - Stock Transfer Dispatch
programStages.description: Transfer stock custody out of source store

programStages.name: INV - Expiry Damage and Disposal
programStages.description: Document approved writeoff of expired, damaged or recalled goods

programStages.name: INV - Stock Adjustment
programStages.description: Correct counting discrepancies after approval

programStages.name: INV - Stock Reservation
programStages.description: Reserve quantities without reducing physical stock

programStages.name: INV - Stock Requisition
programStages.description: Request replenishment from another store or supplier

programStages.name: INV - Procurement and Replenishment
programStages.description: Track order and receipt references; purchasing system remains authoritative
